text:
Aisha (PM): quick sync — we shipped v1.3 last night. Two follow-on asks from customers (embed cache TTL tweak + condensed results UI) and a regression: memory growth on long streaming sessions. Proposing a 3-week plan: week1 fix regression + hotpatch, week2 small UX + metrics, week3 larger enhancement backlog. thoughts? who can own the regression?
Miguel (Eng): saw the leak in staging repro. It's a KV-cache pinning during KV eviction on long streams. Repro command: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" $ENDPOINT/stream?test=leak` — runs up memory within ~45m. Estimate: temporary mitigation + monitoring: 2d, full root cause & test+fix: ~8d.
Sonal (SRE): impact: ~4% of customer sessions hit >1GB; autoscaler restarts mitigate but not ideal. Can do a 1% canary with restarts disabled to validate fix once Miguel has a patch. Also add an alert for RSS>800MB for streaming nodes.
Ben (Product Designer): the condensed results UI (enhancement) is small — prototype done, dev effort ~3d. The embed cache TTL tweak is just a config knob for some customers — needs validation but very low risk. If we push regression fix first, we can still slide the small UI into week1 if Miguel has bandwidth after mitigation.
Kai (Data): suggest we add a short A/B test for the condensed UI with conversion metric = successful click-to-copy rate. Also baseline token-cost delta for the TTL change.
deploy-bot: deploy started to canary (prod-us-east-1) for v1.3-hotfix at 3321004350 — monitor dashboards: streaming-node-rss, request-latency, error-rate.
Miguel (Eng): plan: 1) apply immediate mitigation (eviction throttle + restart cron) today (2h). 2) push scoped fix branch with unit+integration tests by Thu EOD (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789). 3) full validation on staging + 1% canary next Monday. If green, roll to 100% with 30m ramp.
Sonal (SRE): will own rollout & rollback playbook. My checklist: pre-canary snapshot, alert runbook, surge capacity plan, and a post-mortem template if it reappears.
Aisha (PM): agreed. Decision: bug-first for immediate safety. Side-load Ben's small UI into week2 unless Miguel can spare 3d in week1 after mitigation. Kai will own metrics for both experiments.
Ben (Product Designer): noted — I'll provide final dev spec and assets by Fri morning.
Kai (Data): I'll add dashboards and success criteria: streaming-rss-95p < 700MB, error-rate delta < 0.2%, UI CTR +5% target for condensed UI.
Miguel (Eng): marking owners: Miguel -> regression fix (RDW-1123), Ben -> condensed UI (RDW-1134), Ops -> canary/rollout (RDW-1135). ETA: mitigation today, PR Thu, canary Mon.
Aisha (PM): action items summarized: 1) Miguel mitigation (today) 2) Miguel PR + tests (Thu EOD) 3) Sonal run canary (Mon) 4) Ben spec (Fri AM) 5) Kai dashboards (Fri) 6) follow-up retro next Wed. Ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Eng): :thumbsup: starting mitigation now.
Sonal (SRE): adding alerts and runbook entries, will also keep 30m paging window during canary.
Aisha (PM): thanks everyone — logging this plan to RDW-ICC (internal tracker) and will update the roadmap slice. If anything changes, @here.
